# Create updated regex per semver.org spec and test it
new_regex = re.compile(
    r"""
    ^
    (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9]\d*))
    \.
    (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9]\d*))
    \.
    (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9]\d*))
    (\-(?P<prerelease>
        (?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*)
        (\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*))*
    ))?
    (\+(?P<build>
        [0-9a-zA-Z-]+
        (\.[0-9a-zA-Z-]+)*
    ))?
    $
    """, re.VERBOSE)

test_cases = [
    ("1.2.3", True),
    ("1.2.3-alpha", True),
    ("1.2.3-123", True),       # numeric-only prerelease is valid
    ("1.2.3-0", True),         # zero prerelease
    ("1.2.3-00", False),       # leading zero prerelease
    ("1.2.3-rc.1", True),
    ("1.2.3-1.2.3", True),     # all numeric prerelease segments
    ("1.2.3-αβγ", False),      # non-ASCII
    ("v1.2.3", False),         # prefixed with v
    ("1.2.3+", False),         # trailing +
    ("1.2.3-alpha+b", True),
    ("0.0.0", True),
    ("01.2.3", False),         # leading zero in major
    ("1.0.0-0.3.7", True),     # numeric prerelease
    ("1.0.0-x.7.12.92", True), # alphanumeric prerelease
    ("1.0.0-0.3.7+build.14", True), # full version
    ("1.0.0+20130313144700", True), # build metadata only
    ("1.0.0-beta+exp.sha.5114f8e", True), # both prerelease and build
]

print("Testing new regex:")
all_pass = True
for tc, expected_valid in test_cases:
    m = new_regex.match(tc)
    is_valid = m is not None
    status = "✓" if is_valid == expected_valid else "✗ FAIL"
    if is_valid != expected_valid:
        all_pass = False
    print(f"  {status} {tc} -> {'VALID' if is_valid else 'INVALID'} (expected {'valid' if expected_valid else 'invalid'})")

print(f"\nAll tests passed: {all_pass}")
